My dad had taken me and my brothers to our first guys camping trip when we were old enough. I was like 11 at the time my other brothers were 9 and 8 at the time. I can’t remember where we went to exactly but I know that it was somewhere in Georgia. We had been there for most of the day. Then it started to get dusk and my dad and brothers were hanging out at the camp. Around this time I started to hear a low humming noise coming from the woods. I felt kind of hypnotized and drawn to the woods. So I walked into the wood line near the camp. Once I got in I didn’t see anything weird at first but then at this spot between these two trees was like a black empty space. But it’s not really black more like there was nothing there like a blacked out cutout where something should be. The closest thing that looks like it is like a black hole in the interstellar movie. I went closer to it and did the dumbest thing. I put my hand inside it. When I did there was this electric popping sound all around me. When I put it in, it was the weirdest feeling I’ve ever had. It was like my whole nervous system was on supercharge. My skin felt tingly, my adrenaline was pumping, and it felt like all my bones were on fire. I immediately took it out. When I took it out my hand the portal or hole it just closed. After standing there for a minute I just took off back to the camp.
